### Renormalisation

So I am considering the case that the displayed, relative volume should be a constant value $c$. I am looking for $\epsilon$, to find how the width should be displayed.

$$\frac{\int_{-\epsilon}^{\epsilon} x(p)dp}{\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} x(p)dp}=c$$

The Lorenzian function $x(p)\propto \tfrac{1}{2m_2E-p^2}$ is obtained by Looking at the boundary of the surface of section. If the boundary is considered, we obtain

$$x(p)= \frac{2m_2 \mathcal{C}}{L} \frac{1}{2m_2E-p^2}-\partial\mathcal{B}_{1\text{R}}$$

The integral of the lorenzian term is

$$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{dp}{p^2+\kappa^2} = \frac{\pi}{\kappa}, \qquad \int_{-\varepsilon}^{\varepsilon}\frac{dp}{p^2+\kappa^2} = \frac{2}{\kappa}\arctan\frac{\varepsilon}{\kappa}$$ $$\frac{2}{\pi}\arctan\frac{\varepsilon}{\kappa} = c \quad\Longrightarrow\quad \boxed{\varepsilon = \sqrt{-2mE}\;\tan\!\left(\frac{\pi c}{2}\right)}, \qquad 0<c<1.$$

As the boundary only funcitons as an offset, and only cases $E<0$ shall be considered, this consideres the problem to be solved.
